def buildColumn(field, title, justify, sortable, hdrStyle, rowStyle, width, visible):
		return {
				  "field": field,
				  "visible": visible,
				  "editable": False,
				  "render": "auto",
				  "justify": justify,
				  "align": "center",
				  "resizable": True,
				  "sortable": sortable,
				  "sort": "none",
				  "filter": {"enabled": False, "visible": "on-hover", "string": {"condition": "", "value": "" }, "number": {"condition": "", "value": ""}, "boolean": {"condition": ""}, "date": {"condition": "", "value": ""}},
				  "viewPath": "",
				  "viewParams": {},
				  "boolean": "checkbox",
				  "number": "value",
				  "progressBar": {"max": 100, "min": 0, "bar": {"color": "", "style": {"classes": ""}}, "track": {"color": "", "style": {"classes": ""}}, "value": {"enabled": True, "format": "0,0.##", "justify": "center", "style": {"classes": ""}}},
				  "toggleSwitch": {"color": {"selected": "", "unselected": ""}},
				  "NoneFormat": {"includeNoneStrings": False, "strict": False, "NoneFormatValue": ""},
				  "numberFormat": "0,0.##",
				  "dateFormat": "MM/DD/YY HH:mm",
				  "width": width,
				  "strictWidth": True,
				  "style": rowStyle,
				  "header": {"title": title, "justify": justify, "align": "center", "style": hdrStyle},
				  "footer": {"title": "", "justify": "left", "align": "center", "style": {"classes": "" }}
				}

	colInfo = self.custom.updateColumns
	if not colInfo.has_key('columns'): return
	if not colInfo.has_key('startingCol'): return
	if not colInfo.has_key('numOfCols'): return	
	if colInfo.startingCol is None: return
	if colInfo.numOfCols is None: return
	if colInfo.columns is None: return

	hdrStyle = {'backgroundColor' : '--kcBlue-10', 'fontWeight': 'bold', 'fontSize' : '12px', 'borderBottomWidth' : '1px' , 'borderBottomStyle' : 'solid','borderBottomColor':'#D5D5D5'}
	rowStyle = ({'backgroundColor' : '--kcBlue-10', 'fontSize' : '10px','borderRightWidth' : '1px' , 'borderRightStyle' : 'solid','borderRightColor':'#C1C1C1'})
	colHeader = system.dataset.getColumnHeaders(self.props.data)

	cols = [{'colName':'takenDate', 'title':'Taken Date', 'justify': 'left', 'width':110, 'visible': True}]
	if self.custom.updateColumns.displaySettings.showFooter:
		cols.append({'colName':'shiftName', 'title':'Shift', 'justify': 'left', 'width':70,'sortable':True, 'visible':True})
		cols.append({'colName':'itemName','title':'Item', 'width':100, 'justify': 'center', 'sortable':False, 'visible': True})
		cols.append({'colName':'assetPath', 'title':'Asset', 'justify': 'left', 'width':160, 'sortable':False, 'visible': True})
		cols.append({'colName':'chkShtStateName', 'title':'Status', 'justify': 'left', 'width':70,'sortable':True, 'visible':True})

#	cols = [{'colName':'takenDate', 'title':'Taken Date', 'justify': 'left', 'width':110, 'visible': True}]

	fixedColumns = [buildColumn(item['colName'], item['title'], item['justify'], True, hdrStyle, rowStyle, item['width'], item['visible']) for item in cols if item['colName'] in colHeader]

	self.view.custom.table.columns.fixedColLength = len([i for i in fixedColumns if i['visible']])
	self.props.columns = list(fixedColumns) +  colInfo.columns[colInfo.startingCol:colInfo.startingCol + colInfo.numOfCols]

	return

def getChkItemColName(dci):
		for item in value['itemInfo']:
			if item['chkItemId'] == int(dci.replace('dci_','')): return item['chkItemGroupName'] + ' ' + item['chkItemName'] if value.displaySettings.showCheckItemPath else item['chkItemName']
		return dci

	def buildColumn(field, title, justify, sortable, hdrStyle, rowStyle, visible):
		return {
				  "field": field,
				  "visible": visible,
				  "editable": False,
				  "render": "auto",
				  "justify": justify,
				  "align": "center",
				  "resizable": True,
				  "sortable": sortable,
				  "sort": "none",
				  "filter": {"enabled": False, "visible": "on-hover", "string": {"condition": "", "value": "" }, "number": {"condition": "", "value": ""}, "boolean": {"condition": ""}, "date": {"condition": "", "value": ""}},
				  "viewPath": "",
				  "viewParams": {},
				  "boolean": "checkbox",
				  "number": "value",
				  "progressBar": {"max": 100, "min": 0, "bar": {"color": "", "style": {"classes": ""}}, "track": {"color": "", "style": {"classes": ""}}, "value": {"enabled": True, "format": "0,0.##", "justify": "center", "style": {"classes": ""}}},
				  "toggleSwitch": {"color": {"selected": "", "unselected": ""}},
				  "NoneFormat": {"includeNoneStrings": False, "strict": False, "NoneFormatValue": ""},
				  "numberFormat": "0,0.##",
				  "dateFormat": "MM/DD/YYYY HH:mm",
				  "width": 90,
				  "strictWidth": True,
				  "style": rowStyle,
				  "header": {"title": title, "justify": justify, "align": "center", "style": hdrStyle},
				  "footer": {"title": "", "justify": "left", "align": "center", "style": {"classes": "" }}
				}

	hdrStyle = {'backgroundColor' : '--kcBlue-10', 'fontWeight': 'bold', 'fontSize' : '10px', 'borderBottomWidth' : '1px' , 'borderBottomStyle' : 'solid','borderBottomColor':'#D5D5D5'}

	colHeader = system.dataset.getColumnHeaders(value['data'])
	colsToRemove = ['takenDate', 'assetPath', 'itemName', 'shiftName', 'chkShtStateColor', 'chkShtStateName']
	colHeader = [hdr for hdr in colHeader if hdr not in colsToRemove]

	rowStyle = ({'backgroundColor' : '--kcBlue-0', 'fontSize' : '10px','borderRightWidth' : '1px' , 'borderRightStyle' : 'solid','borderRightColor':'#C1C1C1'})
	return [buildColumn(colName, colName, 'center', False, hdrStyle, rowStyle, True) for colName in colHeader]	#This list is ordered by the items sort order

minStartCol = 0 								#this is our min value for 0%
	maxStartCol = len(value.cols) - value.numCols	#this should be our max value for 100%
	increment = (maxStartCol - minStartCol) / 100.0

 	splitPosition = int(value.splitPercent.replace('%',''))
	return int(splitPosition * increment)

def getChkItemInfo(chkItemPath):
		for item in value['itemInfo']:
			if item['chkItemPath'] == chkItemPath: return item
		return None
	
	def buildFootCol(title, span, justify, fontWeight):
		return {"title": title, "span": span, "justify": justify, "align": "center", "style": {"classes": "", 'padding':'5px', 'backgroundColor':'--kcGray-10', 'fontWeight': fontWeight}}

	if value.displaySettings.showSummary:
		calcs = ['Units', 'Average', 'Sum', 'Min', 'Max', 'Range', 'STDev']
		footers = [[buildFootCol(calcs[y], self.view.custom.table.columns.fixedColLength,  'right', 'bold') for i in range(len(value.cols))] for y in range(len(calcs))]
	
		data = value.filterData if len(value.filterData) > 0 else system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(value.data)
		if len(data) == 0: return []
		
		for i, col in enumerate(value.cols[self.view.custom.table.columns.fixedColLength:]):
			chkItemInfo = getChkItemInfo(col.field)
			values = [float(row[col.field]) for row in data if row[col.field] is not None] if chkItemInfo['isNumeric'] else [None for row in data]
			engUnit = chkItemInfo['engUnitName']
	
			y = 0			
			footers[y][i+1] = buildFootCol(engUnit, 1, 'right', 'normal')
			footers[y+1][i+1] = buildFootCol(str(round(system.math.mean(values),3)), 1, 'right', 'normal') if chkItemInfo['isNumeric'] else buildFootCol('', 1, 'right', 'normal')
			footers[y+2][i+1] = buildFootCol(str(round(system.math.sum(values),3)), 1, 'right', 'normal') if chkItemInfo['isNumeric'] else buildFootCol('', 1, 'right', 'normal')
			footers[y+3][i+1] = buildFootCol(str(round(system.math.min(values),3)), 1, 'right', 'normal') if chkItemInfo['isNumeric'] else buildFootCol('', 1, 'right', 'normal')
			footers[y+4][i+1] = buildFootCol(str(round(system.math.max(values),3)), 1, 'right', 'normal') if chkItemInfo['isNumeric'] else buildFootCol('', 1, 'right', 'normal')
			footers[y+5][i+1] = buildFootCol(str(round(system.math.max(values) - system.math.min(values),3)), 1, 'right', 'normal') if chkItemInfo['isNumeric'] else buildFootCol('', 1, 'right', 'normal')
			footers[y+6][i+1] = buildFootCol(str(round(system.math.standardDeviation(values),3)), 1, 'right', 'normal') if chkItemInfo['isNumeric'] else buildFootCol('', 1, 'right', 'normal')
			
	if value.displaySettings.get('showSpec'):
		calcs = ['Units', 'Average', 'Sum', 'Min', 'Max', 'Range', 'STDev']
		footers = [[buildFootCol(calcs[y], self.view.custom.table.columns.fixedColLength,  'right', 'bold') for i in range(len(value.cols))] for y in range(len(calcs))]
	
		data = value.filterData if len(value.filterData) > 0 else system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(value.data)
		if len(data) == 0: return []
		
		for i, col in enumerate(value.cols[self.view.custom.table.columns.fixedColLength:]):
			chkItemInfo = getChkItemInfo(col.field)
			values = [float(row[col.field]) for row in data if row[col.field] is not None] if chkItemInfo['isNumeric'] else [None for row in data]
			engUnit = chkItemInfo['engUnitName']
	
			y = 0			
			footers[y][i+1] = buildFootCol(engUnit, 1, 'right', 'normal')
			footers[y+1][i+1] = buildFootCol(str(round(system.math.mean(values),3)), 1, 'right', 'normal') if chkItemInfo['isNumeric'] else buildFootCol('', 1, 'right', 'normal')
			footers[y+2][i+1] = buildFootCol(str(round(system.math.sum(values),3)), 1, 'right', 'normal') if chkItemInfo['isNumeric'] else buildFootCol('', 1, 'right', 'normal')
			footers[y+3][i+1] = buildFootCol(str(round(system.math.min(values),3)), 1, 'right', 'normal') if chkItemInfo['isNumeric'] else buildFootCol('', 1, 'right', 'normal')
			footers[y+4][i+1] = buildFootCol(str(round(system.math.max(values),3)), 1, 'right', 'normal') if chkItemInfo['isNumeric'] else buildFootCol('', 1, 'right', 'normal')
			footers[y+5][i+1] = buildFootCol(str(round(system.math.max(values) - system.math.min(values),3)), 1, 'right', 'normal') if chkItemInfo['isNumeric'] else buildFootCol('', 1, 'right', 'normal')
			footers[y+6][i+1] = buildFootCol(str(round(system.math.standardDeviation(values),3)), 1, 'right', 'normal') if chkItemInfo['isNumeric'] else buildFootCol('', 1, 'right', 'normal')

	return footers
